HISD Pagination

Pagination splits a long result set into navigable pages. Each panel below shows every state — the current page (aria-current="page" on --color-action), unselected pages, hover, focus, an ellipsis gap for elided ranges, and the Previous / Next buttons disabled at the first and last bounds. The root is a <nav> whose aria-label ends in the word pagination (e.g. aria-label="Search results pagination"), so the landmark name carries the APG pattern while still distinguishing multiple pagination navs on one page; Previous / Next are icon-bearing buttons with an aria-label. The right panel is forced to data-theme="dark"; the component inherits dark purely through semantic tokens — no component-specific dark CSS. Keyboard: Tab moves between controls, Enter / Space activates; every target is ≥ 24 px.

Copy-paste snippet

<nav class="hisd-pagination" aria-label="Search results pagination">
  <ul class="hisd-pagination__list" role="list">
    <li class="hisd-pagination__item">
      <!-- Disabled at the first bound: native disabled + aria-disabled -->
      <button type="button"
              class="hisd-pagination__nav hisd-pagination__nav--prev"
              aria-label="Previous page" disabled aria-disabled="true">
        <span class="hisd-pagination__icon" aria-hidden="true"></span>
        <span class="hisd-pagination__label">Previous</span>
      </button>
    </li>

    <li class="hisd-pagination__item">
      <a href="?page=1" class="hisd-pagination__link"
         aria-label="Page 1" aria-current="page">1</a>
    </li>
    <li class="hisd-pagination__item">
      <a href="?page=2" class="hisd-pagination__link" aria-label="Page 2">2</a>
    </li>
    <li class="hisd-pagination__item">
      <a href="?page=3" class="hisd-pagination__link" aria-label="Page 3">3</a>
    </li>

    <!-- Elided range: presentational, hidden from assistive tech -->
    <li class="hisd-pagination__item">
      <span class="hisd-pagination__ellipsis" aria-hidden="true">…</span>
    </li>

    <li class="hisd-pagination__item">
      <a href="?page=12" class="hisd-pagination__link" aria-label="Page 12">12</a>
    </li>

    <li class="hisd-pagination__item">
      <button type="button"
              class="hisd-pagination__nav hisd-pagination__nav--next"
              aria-label="Next page">
        <span class="hisd-pagination__label">Next</span>
        <span class="hisd-pagination__icon" aria-hidden="true"></span>
      </button>
    </li>
  </ul>

  <!-- Optional live summary: announces the page change to screen readers -->
  <p class="hisd-pagination__status" role="status" aria-live="polite">
    Page 1 of 12
  </p>
</nav>

<!-- Keyboard comes free from native <a> / <button>: Tab to move,
     Enter/Space to activate. Active page carries aria-current="page";
     prev/next set BOTH disabled and aria-disabled="true" at the bounds. -->
